The Friday draft cannot slip. Please confirm the review arrangement.
“评审请移到白天，周五交草稿。事由保留。”
Please move the review to daytime. Draft on Friday. Reason withheld.
还没有听见这一层需要。
You have not heard the need beneath this request.
“我怕交付落空后，又是我一个人承担。”
I'm afraid I'll be left carrying the missed delivery alone.
“我需要保留不解释私事的空间。这句，我想自己说。”
I need room to keep my reasons private. I want to say this myself.
“我需要知道，在他的生活里还有我的位置。”
I need to know there is still a place for me in his life.
“我需要自己作决定，也想和她保持联系。”
I need my own decisions, and I want to stay connected.
对方较能听完一句不舒服的话。
They are more ready to hear something uncomfortable.
对方仍在防备；照搬责备会降低信任。
They are guarded. Repeating blame will cost trust.

“我愿意告诉你，但这句，我想自己说。”
亲近没有替他让渡公开这句话的权利。

I'm willing to tell you. I want to say this myself.
Closeness does not surrender control of private words.

“这句可以带过去。别替我保证结果。”
你获得的是转述许可，还不是直接对话的同意。

You may share this. Don't promise how it will turn out.

“这句先留在我们之间。”
你听见了拒绝。这一轮不再重复追问许可。

Keep this between us for now.
You hear the refusal, and will not ask again this round.

你回到原主面前，收回替人传话的承诺。
对方有点失望；你把限度说清楚了。

You return to the speaker and give back your promise.
They are disappointed. Your limit is now clear.

你把私下听见的需要留在这里。
不公开它，也是一种处理。

You keep the private need between you.
Not sharing it is also a way to handle it.

你承认了擅自转述，并重新征询意愿。
对方仍愿意尝试；这份同意只属于本人。

You acknowledge sharing without permission, and ask again.
They are still willing to try. This yes belongs only to them.

你承认了擅自转述。信任恢复了一点。
道歉没有替对方许下和解。

You acknowledge sharing without permission. Some trust returns.
Your apology does not promise reconciliation for them.

对方听见了需要，原主却失去了对私下话语的决定权。
你获得了一点亲近，也留下了一次需要承认的越界。

The listener hears a need. Its owner loses control of private words.
Closeness comes with a breach you will need to acknowledge.

“这比刚才的责备，更像是能回答的一句话。”
你带来了获准分享的需要，没有替任何人保证结果。

That sounds like something I can answer.
You carry an allowed need, without guaranteeing an outcome.

对方听完了原话，没有马上把它推回来。
准确传达，仍不等于替双方完成了理解。

They hear the original words without pushing them straight back.
An accurate delivery is still not mutual understanding.

“这又是要我照着做吗？”
原话准确到达，责备也跟着进来了。

Am I being told what to do again?
The words arrive accurately. The blame arrives with them.
